full_judgment:
2. The facts, leading to the filing of the petition for leave to appeal, in short, are that one Rahat Bin Anwar lodged an First Information Report against the accused-respondent and his four brothers under sections 143/341/325/302 and 34 of the Penal Code with the Burungamari Police Station. 

 3. Prosecution case, in short, is that the informant had previous enmity with the accused. On 10.12.2009, at about 10 am. while the younger brother of the informant Filed Bin Anwar reached near Joymonirhat Kasai Bazar, at that time, all the accused being armed with lathi, iron rod etc. obstructed his way and then his younger brother tried to flee away out of fear but the accused encircled him and started abusing him in filthy language and pushed him down. After that, accused Shahin Siraj suddenly gave a lathi blow on the back side of his head by a stick and as a result, his brother fell to the ground. Later, other accused started inflicting kicks and blows on the person of the informant's brother. Hearing the shouting of his brother, the informant along with other witnesses went to the place of occurrence, after seeing them the accused fled away. Soon after, the informant along with other witnesses took his injured brother to Burungamari Thana Hospital. As his condition was very critical, the doctor on duty advised them to take him to the Rangpur Medical College Hospital for better treatment and accordingly, the victim was taken to the Rangpur Medical College Hospital and admitted there. After thorough check-up of his physical condition, the doctor advised him to undergo a brain surgery. Since there was lack of adequate facilities in that hospital for such operation, he was quickly referred to Central Clinic at Rangpur Town where the surgery was conducted. While undergoing treatment, he succumbed to the injuries in that Clinic on 12.12.2009 at about 2.30 A.M. After that, the dead body was sent to morgue for post-mortem examination after preparation an inquest report. Soon after, the dead body was handed over to the informant. At this stage, the informant lodged a First Information Report against the accused respondent and his four brothers under sections 143/341/325/302 and 34 of the Penal Code with the Burungamari Police Station resulting in the initiation of Burungamari Police Station Case No. 05 dated 12.12.2009 corresponding to G.R.No. 95 of 2009.
